```sql
WITH anc_coverage AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    NULLIF(SUM(anc4_completed), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(pregnancies_registered), 0) * 100 AS coverage_rate
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'
  GROUP BY district, year
)
SELECT
  district,
  (coverage_rate_2023 - coverage_rate_2021) AS percentage_point_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    district,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN coverage_rate END) AS coverage_rate_2023,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN coverage_rate END) AS coverage_rate_2021
  FROM anc_coverage
  GROUP BY district
) AS rates;
```
